purpose: Verify that the realized crossed family x trait graph can recover the direction and magnitude of a biologically meaningful family-vs-trait variance architecture before real memory-loss rho is opened.
model: y ~ 1 + (1|family) + (1|trait_name), fitted by REML with the same optimizer as the real model
graph: Use only final crossed-core family/trait incidence; simulated responses contain no real rho or trait values.
rationale: A twofold variance ratio is the predeclared minimum architecture contrast the study must be able to distinguish. The absolute total variance corresponds to response SD about 0.14 and keeps simulated rho-scale responses in a realistic range without using the observed effects.
failure_rule: If either directional benchmark fails any admission threshold, stop before opening real family x trait memory effects. Do not strengthen the benchmark, change the graph, or alter the mixed model.
